title: Uncovering Political Hate Speech During Indian Election Campaign: A New Low-Resource Dataset and Baselines
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hate speech in political discourse, including content that exploits religious differences and propagates hateful religious views in the context of Indian elections.
findings: The paper's context highlights that hate speech in Indian political discourse often exploits religious differences. The experimental findings show that automated models, including transformer-based ones like RoBERTa and BERT, are significantly outperformed by human evaluators in detecting this nuanced hate speech, indicating a need for more advanced techniques to moderate content that may include hateful religious views.
